name_ar: جلب ثابت أولا ثم احتياط المتصفح
what: جلب الصفحة ثابتا أولا ثم التصعيد لمتصفح بلا واجهة فقط عند صفحات JS أو الحماية. — Fetch statically first and escalate to headless Chrome only when the page is a JS shell or WAF-blocked.
when: Static fetch returns empty or stub content; SPA, infinite scroll, interstitials.
how: 1) Try static fetch. 2) Check for near-empty body, noscript warnings, WAF vendor fingerprints. 3) Re-fetch with browser mode auto|always|never (always for known SPAs, never in hot loops or sandboxes). 4) Optionally attach external CDP endpoint. 5) Inspect content and warnings fields before trusting result. 6) Script clicks/scroll/wait before extraction when interaction is needed.

name_en: Clinical study endpoint and sample-size gate
what: تقييم نقاط النهاية وتقدير حجم العينة وإصدار قرار جاهزية للدراسة. — Score endpoints, estimate two-arm sample size and score study feasibility into a go/no-go packet.
when: Designing a prospective study before submission.
how: 1) Fill protocol synopsis template. 2) endpoint_selector: 5 weighted dimensions, classify primary/key-secondary/exploratory, flag surrogates. 3) sample_size_estimator for means (Cohen d), proportions, survival (Schoenfeld) with sourced effect size. 4) phase_gate_scorer 0-100 giving GO / GO-WITH-CONDITIONS / REDESIGN / NO-GO plus owners. 5) Route to biostatistician and medical monitor; output is advisory.
